summary: Frontend regression testing of My Labels UAE copy/layout changes. All 8 requested changes verified passing on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Hero badge now reads 'Dubai • Labelling Solutions' (and Arabic 'دبي • حلول الملصقات'), exactly 2 trust stats render (Always On Time + UAE-Wide Delivery), 'Quality Assured'/'ISO-grade' and standalone 'Why Us' removed from rendered UI across all 11 public pages. Header + Footer show 'Why Choose Us' linking to /why-choose-us (page renders). About page mission/vision cards render background images that load with HTTP 200 and remain readable. Floating Enquire (48x48) and Call (48x48) buttons on mobile are compact icon-only and do not overlap hero content; enquiry dialog opens and successful submission shows 'Thank you! Your quote request has been received' toast. Admin login → dashboard → SEO tab all work. Arabic toggle flips html dir to rtl and localizes hero badge and nav. Only console noise is the pre-existing framer-motion deprecation warning.
action_items: Minor cleanup (non-blocking): unused i18n keys hero.stat2 / hero.stat2s ('Quality Assured' / 'ISO-grade output') and Arabic equivalents in /app/frontend/src/i18n/LanguageContext.jsx can be deleted since they are no longer referenced by any component.
Non-blocking: framer-motion prints 'motion() is deprecated. Use motion.create() instead.' console warning across pages — safe to ignore for now but should be migrated at some point.
Observed: after clicking Logout on admin dashboard, URL remained /admin momentarily (likely re-directs on next render). Worth a quick manual check by main agent but did not block regression.
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.jsx duplicates the hero markup that also lives in components/Hero.jsx — Hero.jsx appears to be dead code (not imported). Consider removing it to avoid confusion.
Mission/Vision background URLs are hardcoded absolute URLs to emergentagent CDN in AboutPage.jsx — consider centralising in data/products.js IMG map for consistency with the rest of the codebase.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ enquiry created via floating enquiry form on mobile viewport (name 'TEST_Auto Tester').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 acceptance criteria from iteration_6 review request verified. If further UI copy changes are made, re-run the grep for banned strings ('Quality Assured', 'ISO-grade', standalone 'Why Us') across all 11 public routes and verify Mission/Vision background images still return 200. Console has expected framer-motion deprecation warning only.
